Recorded material, contact and boundary assumptions

  • Body and bolted cable cap flexible; four local perfectly clamped bolt collars. No bolt preload, slip or failure.
  • Motor loaded upper-bound inertia distributed over actual bore nodes; no motor housing stiffness or exact inertia tensor.
  • PA12-CF10 elastic isotropic proxy E=1806.6MPa nu=.35 density1060; print +Z motor axes. No strength/failure claims.
  • No fracture, erosion, motor thrust, carrier, released endcap or invented 35g hardware allowance.
  • Rigid 8mm aluminum spreaders initially stationary; fixed x,y and rotations, free z without travel limit.
  • Pusher transverse bore-quadrant averages are guided by disjoint LINEAR_GLOBAL X/Y equations; every Z DOF is free.
  • All axial stopping reaction passes through transient contact; no axial guide constraint.
  • Foam rear z fixed, x/y free: frictionless fixed backing; sides unconfined.
  • MAT057 synthetic loading and unloading; HU=.05 BETA=0 DAMP=.1 SHAPE=1 FAIL=0. Not a product material model.
  • Generic foam anchored at one catalog point; remaining curve chosen for nonbottoming comparative stop.
  • Startup-only local mass scaling requested; added mass and inertia error MUST be assessed from solver output.
  • Mesh, timestep, energy and momentum require independent assessment.
